title: Transition to post-quantum Public Key Infrastructures
callTitle: Strengthening the cybersecurity ecosystem
descriptionByte:
Expected Outcome:
  • New combiners ensuring that cryptographic schemes provide at least 128-bit security against quantum adversaries.
  • Experimental evaluation on hybrid certificates in several standard protocols that use those certificates, also considering options for different cryptographic algorithms at the root Certification Authority level and at the other levels, in terms of security, performance, and backward compatibility. The impact of such certificates in protocols should be tested via open-source libraries.
  • New and/or improved open-source libraries for certificate requests, issuance, validation, revocation and (privacy-friendly) certificate transparency.
  • Clear procedures taking into account all aspects of key management: requirements for signature generation, in terms of the software and hardware used to create signatures as well as the secure storage and handling of private keys to maintain their authenticity and confidentiality, signature validation, with specification of the data required for verifying signatures and outlining the conditions necessary for a successful signature verification process, signature life-cycle process, and validity status of signatures.
  • Test and evaluation of uses of X.509 certificates other than their core uses.
  • Tests and evaluation of alternatives to X.509 certificates.
  • Awareness activities and training courses.
Objective:

The overarching aim of this call is to tackle the challenges of an effective integration of PQC algorithms in Public Key Infrastructures (PKIs), which offers efficient migration strategies and strong business continuity guarantees.

The call targets the different actors involved in the PKI ecosystems and supply and value chains, who all have a unique set of diverse needs and interdependencies, such as Certificate Authorities (CAs), intermediate CAs, researchers, end-users in different domains, and vendors.

Scope:

Proposals shall target activities on the following subjects:

  • design of digital signature combiners and key encapsulation mechanism combiners.
  • the testing of deployment of certificates in protocols that use those certificates.
  • the development of novel protocols for Automatic Certificate Management and revocation and of novel protocols for (privacy-friendly) certificate-transparency.
  • the development of methods and tools that can be used by experts across various PKI domains, including all aspects of key management of asymmetric systems.

Proposals should carefully consider the requirements and constraints, such as security level, performance and business continuity, in a broad range of applications relevant for critical societal sectors and processes (such as governmental services, telecom, banking, smart homes, e-Health, automotive, and other sectors).

Proposals should address functions such as key establishment, digital signatures, and secure communication protocols that require careful adaptation with post-quantum counterparts to ensure resilience against threats posed by quantum-capable adversaries.

Proposals should safeguard compatibility with existing legacy systems. To achieve this, a transition to PKIs that support both pre-quantum and post-quantum cryptography should be addressed. The proposed systems should be able to seamlessly interact with legacy systems by disabling the post-quantum component as needed while preventing downgrade attacks. Relying solely on PQC solutions in this intermediate transition phase could introduce security risks given that the security analysis of the cryptosystems and of their implementations is not as mature as for their pre-quantum counterparts. Proposals should therefore use combinations of PQC solutions and established pre-quantum solutions, making sure to provide strongest-link security, meaning that the system remains secure as long as at least one of the components of the combination is secure.

For certificates for protocols that support negotiation, such as X.509 certificates for the Transport Layer (TLS), the use of post-quantum key exchange has already been demonstrated and can be implemented in a decentralised manner. Many other protocols need to be migrated, and this process will be more complex when old and new configurations must coexist. Moreover, for applications in IoT, smartcards, identity documents and others, the migration strategies defined for the core use cases of X.509 may well not work.

Proposals should develop clear procedures to effectively guide the various stakeholders involved in PKIs across different usage domains through the transition process.

Effective consortia should comprise a diverse range of actors along the entire PKI chain, encompassing expertise in areas such as software development, hardware implementation, cryptographic research, standardisation, policy, and application deployment, as well as organisations that can provide user case studies and real-world applications.

Activities should include some or all of the following:

  • Identification of requirements necessary to implement hybrid certificates.
  • Development of approaches and techniques for constructing cryptographic combiners for different protocols.
  • Testing of the combiners for issuance of new certificates for the different applications, taking into consideration the need to balance the growth of key, signature, and ciphertext sizes, which can lead to compatibility issues with standards, such as PKI certificates, revocation mechanisms, (privacy-friendly) certificate transparency mechanisms, the use of different cryptographic protocols across certificate chains, the applications requirements, such as security level, time-constraints in signing and verification steps, communication/computational and storage overhead, and hardware optimisation requirements.
  • Development of and/or further improvement of open-source libraries.
  • Development of novel protocols for Automatic Certificate Management and revocation, and of novel protocols for (privacy-friendly) certificate-transparency. Support to standardisation activities.
  • Development of recipes for the design and deployment of the new PKIs, with analysis that depends on each component of a given PKI. • Tests on specialised uses of X.509 certificates other than the core cases using TLS, such as roots of trust, device integrity, firmware signing, and others.
  • Design, improvement and testing of X.509 alternatives, such as, among others, Merkle tree ladders, the GNU Name System, older proposals such as SPKI and SDSI and the use of key encapsulation mechanisms for on-demand authentication in place of signatures.
  • Awareness and training activities for stakeholders with different profiles, emphasising the interdependencies in the transition and facilitating a broader understanding of the technical standards amongst PKI users.

Participation of non-EU entities entails the risk of highly sensitive information about security infrastructure, risks and incidents being subject to legislation or pressure that obliges those non-EU entities to disclose this information to non-EU governments, with an unpredictable security risk. Therefore, based on the outlined security reasons, this topic is subject to Article 12(5) of Regulation (EU) 2021/694.

beneficiaryAdministration:
All submissions must be made by 17:00 Brussels local time on August 26th 2025.

Proposal submission is exclusively in electronic form using the proposal submission tool accessible via the Fortissimo web-site:

https://www.ffplus-project.eu/en/open-call/business-experiments/

The central component of proposal submission is the uploading of a spread-sheet containing administrative information and a PDF-document (whose size must not exceed 5.0 MB) compliant with the instructions on proposal structure given below.

Proposals must be submitted in English. Each proposal must comprise 2 parts: Part A (containing administrative information), Part B (containing the body of the proposal, the structure of which is explained below).

Part A of the proposal will be submitted as a spread-sheet containing a set of tables to provide administrative data, including a tabular list of proposal participants. The participant list should include for each participant the Participant Identification Code (PIC) issued by the European Commission and valid address, telephone number and email contact data.

(To obtain a PIC, register at    https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/participant-register . Please note that having a PIC is not a requirement of the call.)

Only requested information should be included in Part A, conform with the template spreadsheet provided. Additional extraneous information will be deleted before evaluation.

The main section of the proposal – Part B – must not exceed 10 pages in length (including any appendices, but excluding the Part B cover page). The Part B text should be no smaller than 11-point Arial font; which applies also to images inserted into the proposal that provide textual information. Proposals submitted with a Part B whose length (excluding the cover page) exceeds the 10-page limit will be rejected without further evaluation.


The criteria for evaluation will comprise:

  1. Impact: industrial relevance (including potentially societal relevance), exploitation plans and alignment with the objectives of the call.
  2. Excellence: Soundness of concept, business innovation, and quality of the work plan.
  3. Quality of the consortium4: as a whole and of the individual proposers including their ability to carry out the proposed work.
  4. Resources: Effective and justified deployment of resources.


Criteria 1 to 4 will carry a score ranging from 0 to 5. Criterion 1 will have a weight of 2×, Criteria 2 to 4 a weight of 1× (leading to a maximum score of 25 points). A threshold score of 3 will apply to the first three criteria. In case of a tie in the overall score ranking, proposals are ranked based on the individual criteria scoring applying the following priority: Impact, Excellence, Quality of the Consortium, Resources, and finally total requested funding.

The evaluation of proposals will be done by independent, external experts using a consensus review process; which process will be supported by the FFplus beneficiaries coordinating the open call. Each proposal will be assigned two external expects with demonstrated competency in the field of the experiment proposal, that will, independently of one another, produce individual assessment reports. In a consensus session, a moderator works with the two individual evaluators to create a consensus assessment report, representing the consensus position of both experts. The consensus report is turned into an evaluation summary report that will be shared with the proposing consortium.

The individual assessment reports, consensus reports and evaluation summary reports are structured conform with the evaluation criteria listed above.

Adherence to the proposal format and structure described previously – and notably to the prescribed page limit – will allow the independent external evaluators to evaluate the proposal against all of the above-mentioned evaluation criteria. As explained earlier in this document, failure to adhere to the funding and eligibility restrictions and to the proposal format instructions will lead to immediate rejection of the proposal. The proposers will be provided with the results of the evaluation in the form of an evaluation summary report comprising the consolidated findings of the independent expert evaluators and a decision from the project on the result of the selection procedure. That decision is final and the project will not enter into discussions concerning the evaluation results, and no appeals process will be provided.

The successful proposal consortia selected for funding will be included as sub-projects on conclusion of a funding agreement between the University of Stuttgart (the FFplus project Coordinator) and the Partner(s) involved in the proposal. That funding agreement is provided on the project website and is non-negotiable and no changes or modifications are permitted. With the submission of a proposal, the proposer(s) acknowledge this.
description:
This announcement is the second call for proposals to address the uptake of HPC by SMEs in order to solve specific business challenges of SMEs that have had no prior use of, or experience with, HPC services. The resulting sub-projects will perform “business experiments” (also referred to below just as experiments) that should demonstrate to the broader European SME ecosystem that HPC uptake solves business challenges and leads to positive business impact (including but not limited to increased innovation potential and competitiveness) through the use and deployment of HPC-based computational methods (modelling and simulation, data analytics, AI, etc.). Thus, their key outputs are success stories that promote, communicate, and disseminate the business impact of HPC uptake to the SME ecosystem. The development of the innovation potential of the participating SMEs is also directly targeted and an important objective for the proposed business experiments.

The call targets highest quality experiments involving innovative, agile SMEs with work plans built around innovation targets arising from the use of advanced HPC services. Proposals are sought that address business challenges from European SMEs from varied application domains, whereby SMEs whose adoption of advanced HPC services will create the highest business impact will be prioritized. SMEs with an academic focus, for example with business models around R&D services based on HPC software, or activities with a potential impact only in the long term, such as fundamental research, are not within the scope of the call.

FFplus seeks to promote a widening of the HPC user base amongst European SMEs and thus targets a broad geographical distribution of participants. SMEs based in countries with a previously low level of HPC adoption are encouraged to submit a proposal and may expect to be assisted by their national HPC Competence Centre (info at https://www.eurocc-access.eu).


This FFplus call is complementary to the open call for proposals for the Development of Generative AI Models (Identifier FFplus_Call-2-Type-2). It should be noted that SMEs (with the role of main participant) may only participate in one of the two types of sub-projects; i.e. participation is mutually exclusive. Since this call for business experiments targets SMEs with no prior experience with HPC services, a participation as main participant SME in a business experiment funded under the first call for proposals makes that SME ineligible for participation as main participant SME in a business experiment funded under this call; a participation as supporting participant would be dependent on total funding constraints

The proposed business experiments are expected to:

  1. Be fully aligned with the FFplus call objectives defined above.
  2. Define the business challenge that needs to be addressed, justifying why this is a challenge and why HPC is needed to address it.
  3. Present a vision of success, i.e. how addressing the business challenge using HPC will lead to positive business impact. If applicable, define the value propositions and the process of value creation.
  4. Define specific objectives that must be achieved in order to successfully address the business challenge and the accompanying action plan. Furthermore, if necessary, involve the necessary parties required for the effective and efficient execution of the experiment and the demonstration of the impact on SME business challenges through the use of HPC systems or advanced HPC services. Appropriate technical management within an experiment is a required component. Key indicators include revenue generated over recent years, and the existence of a customer base beyond the academic realm.
  5. Define the resources needed to meet objectives and the associated costs. This potentially includes computing costs; please see the section “HPC Computing Resources” below.
  6. Declare any data protection issues that might impact its proposed work plan, define data/information protection mechanisms addressing these in the framework of European law, and ensure that the operation of the experiment adheres to these.
  7. Support the FFplus project in the generation of publishable success stories – including in multi-media form – which discuss how the SME’s real-world problems were addressed and clearly identify the business benefits realised or obtained.
  8. Be complementary to past Fortissimo experiments, i.e. avoid duplication of specific activities carried out in the prior Fortissimo, Fortissimo 2, and FF4EuroHPC projects or in the FFplus sub-projects from the first open call.


In the context of the Fortissimo Plus calls, complementarity of experiments is understood to mean activities that address new applications, services, business cases, industrial sectors and market segments and the enhancement of the project’s ability to demonstrate the impact of the Fortissimo approach for a broad set of industrial users. Proposals that just extend past experiments are thus not considered to be complementary.

callTitle: Second call for business experiments addressing the uptake of HPC by SMEs
furtherInformation:
FFplus is funded by the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC JU) action DIGITAL-EUROHPC-JU-2023-SME-01 "Supporting the competitiveness and innovation potential of SMEs". The central objective of the action is to empower SMEs with advanced computational capabilities based on HPC, enabling them to drive innovation, enhance competitiveness, and overcome challenges in the digitisation of R&D and business processes.

Consequently, the work carried out under FFplus will lead to innovative business experiments (addressed in this call) and innovation studies that will showcase the benefits of adopting HPC for SMEs and Start-ups throughput Europe.

Business experiments will highlight the value of HPC adoption for SMEs across Europe. Whilst High-Performance Computing (HPC) and a range of associated fields of study and technologies, from numerical simulation to Artificial Intelligence (AI), are increasingly becoming versatile, widely deployed tools for both academia and large industrial organizations, there is still action needed to ensure the uptake of these novel technologies by Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs) that lack the required expertise. Innovation studies, in contrast, will support European SMEs and Start-ups already active in the field of generative AI technology, which lack the necessary computational resources to scale up.

In particular, the FFplus project will use open-calls for proposals to select business experiments and innovation studies (also referred to as sub-projects) that will be funded through the mechanism of Financial Support for Third Parties (FSTP). Over the duration of the project, FFplus will provide over € 24 million to such sub-projects selected through a total of six open calls: three of which will target SMEs using HPC to improve their business (business experiments), and three of which will target SMEs/Start-ups in the field of generative artificial intelligence (innovation studies).


FFplus will make use of the FSTP (Financial Support of Third Parties) funding method for the experiment consortia selected through the open call. For all sub-projects funded under FSTP, an agreement will be concluded between the experiment consortium and the FFplus Coordinator; provisions for avoidance of conflicts of interest between sub-projects will be anchored in that agreement. Before conclusion of the funding agreements, the SME will be required to document their status as SME in line with European Commission definitions.

Third Parties will receive 100% funding of incurred, eligible direct costs necessary for the completion of experiment activities; no indirect costs or overheads will be funded. The FFplus project receives funding based on a Grant Agreement following the regulations of the Digital Europe Programme and the eligibility rules of that Grant Agreement will apply for the direct costs arising in the sub-projects.

Consortia selected for funding via the proposal evaluation process will be invited to conclude a funding agreement with the FFplus project coordinator, the University of Stuttgart. That funding agreement will define the payment schedule, whereby payment will be made in multiple tranches, partly linked to the delivery of reports and outputs defined in the experiment workplan and in the funding agreement itself. The principle followed will be that the experiment participants will receive an advance payment at the start of the experiment followed by subsequent instalments.

The following funding conditions and eligibility criteria for participation apply:

  1. The experiments should address the business challenges of an SME new to the use of HPC and that SME may participate in only one experiment as main participant.
  2. A main participant is an SME or a startup and supporting participants are organisations supporting the main participant in the technical work needed to achieve the objectives defined for the experiment.
  3. Applications are to be submitted by one or more main participants sharing a business case/challenge and optionally one or more supporting participants. Each consortium partner needs to have a clearly defined role.
  4. The total number of consortium partners (main participants and supporting participants) is limited to five (5).
  5. Only organisations established in a) an EU Member State or b) (non-EU countries:) listed EEA countries and countries associated to the Digital Europe Programme where the association agreement entered into force before the submission deadline of this call are eligible to receive funding. Natural persons (individuals) are not eligible to receive funding.
  6. SME participation in the FFplus innovation studies for generative AI development and in the business experiments covered by this open call are mutually exclusive. That is, for the SMEs whose business challenge defines the business experiment or innovation study, funding may only be provided for one type of action (Type 1 or Type 2 sub-project). This will be considered during the evaluation and selection process.
  7. FFplus beneficiaries are ineligible to participate as either main or supporting participants.
  8. The maximum duration of the experiments is 15 months, with a maximum funding budget of 200 K€. The maximum funding per organisation is 150 K€. For supporting participants, the maximum funding applies to all business experiments, for all FFplus calls, in which they participate.
  9. In principle, at least 50% of the funding applied for should be allocated to the main participants. Any deviations from this principle must be duly justified.
  10. For supporting participants, only engineering/technical activities are eligible for funding. Activities such as business consultancy, marketing initiatives, administrative tasks, and other non-engineering/non-technical activities are not eligible for funding.



The FFplus project is not in a position to provide HPC computing resources itself, nor does it have any special allocation or preferred-priority access to the HPC systems of the EuroHPC JU. As explained below, there is an expectation that FFplus sub-projects make use of the HPC resources provided under the EuroHPC JU access schemes, which services are provided free of charge. The use of nationally provisioned HPC resources is considered equivalent.

In general, the EuroHPC JU access schemes are organised as a number of different calls for proposals with differing submission dates and available resource volumes and lengths of access and including specific opportunities for industrial users. Proposers are referred to the EuroHPC JU website for regularly updated information about the various access calls, which are organised in the two areas “supercomputers access” and “AI Factories access”:

https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/supercomputers/supercomputers-access-policy-and-faq_en

https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/ai-factories/ai-factories-access-calls_en


Depending on the type of methodologies foreseen to be used in the proposed business experiment, both access areas are relevant for FFplus sub-projects. The HPC National Competence Centres may be able to aid proposers with the selection of appropriate resources and access schemes and the related application process.

When suitably justified, the use of 3rd party commercial HPC resources is permissible, but the corresponding costs need to be taken into account within the proposal budget. Similarly, the use of resources provided by an organisation, such as an HPC centre, included within the sub-project consortium as supporting participant (explained in the following section) is permissible when suitably justified. It should be noted that the provision and cost of charged HPC resources by a supporting partner must be based on actual costs and not commercial rates. These costs have to be included in the experiment’s budget as “other direct cost” of the partner providing the HPC resources to the experiment consortium.

The budget modules available for experiments are listed below, noting that costs for sub-contracting are not included (and thus ineligible for funding):

Personnel

Personnel costs need to be commensurate with the work to be performed

Equipment

Depreciation costs only. Only specialized equipment necessary for conducting the experiment is permitted. Costs for common-use equipment such as laptops, monitors, etc., are not eligible.

Travel

Travel must be justified in terms of the necessity for performance of the proposed experiment work plan.

HPC compute capacity

Compute Resources need to be justified. Ideally, EuroHPC systems will be used for the work. A decision not to apply for access to the EuroHPC systems should be duly justified.

Material

  1. Costs for acquiring specialized SW licenses for conducting the experiment (licenses for general office software, for example, are not eligible).
  2. Costs for acquiring or using data sets or collections needed to conduct the experiment.



The experiments will receive support from the project with a range of actions relating to interactions with the project and also relating to potential collaborations with other sub-projects. Furthermore, direct support for each individual experiment will be provided relating to gaining access to EuroHPC JU-provided computing resources and technical consultation relating to the effective execution of the experiment work plan.



The structure of the proposal Part B (and indicative length per section) should be as follows (the maximum number of pages is the critical aspect as described above):

  1. Summary (0.5 pages)
  2. Industrial relevance, potential impact (including societal impact) and exploitation plans (3.5 pages)
  3. Description of the work plan and concept, including the expected HPC computing needs (3 pages)
  4. Quality of the consortium as a whole and of the individual proposers (2 pages)
  5. Justification of costs and resources (1 page)

A management structure will be established for the successful proposals. That is, the proposal will not need to contain a description of how the management of the experiment in the framework of the overall FFplus project will be achieved, but should include tasks for the technical management of the experiment activities.

descriptionByte:
Expected Outcome:

The core functions of DETs include, but are not limited to:

  1. Deployment of Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools on the cloud: DETs will manage secured cloud instances facilitating access to essential design tools and simulation environments. To this end, DETs may contract with a cloud provider of their choice to setup this infrastructure. It is expected that prospective DETs demonstrate experience in commercial designs using tools from established EDA vendors.
  2. Design flow support and customisation: DETs will assist users in setting up and customising design environments and flows, ensuring smooth progression from initial setup to tape-out.
  3. Application engineering: DETs will offer dedicated application engineering support, addressing specific user needs and challenges throughout the development process.
  4. Access to Process Design Kits (PDKs): DETs will provide users with access to the necessary PDKs and ADKs for their design projects. Each DET must have legal authorisation to use and/or provide its users access to PDKs/ADKs of at least one semiconductor foundry.
  5. Design expertise: DETs will provide users with access to the necessary design expertise for their design projects, directly via the DET’s resources and/or through partnerships with third parties.
  6. Prototyping and fabrication services: DETs will facilitate prototyping and fabrication services including packaging and testing through partnerships with leading foundries or aggregators, the Chips for Europe Initiative pilot lines or other relevant pilot lines. Each DET must have already established direct or indirect relationships with at least one semiconductor foundry, enabling efficient communication and ensuring technology advice and support to its users.

Центрове Europe DIRECT:

  • Информират за политиките и действията на ЕС
  • Приемат и отговарят на питания на гражданите по въпроси, които попадат в обхвата на отговорността на ЕС
  • Общуват с гражданите относно въздействието на ЕС в ежедневието им
  • Допринасят за европейското гражданско образование
  • Допринасят за създаването на европейска публична сфера

Центровете Europe DIRECT са добре свързани с местните общности и организират комуникационни и информационни дейности по теми на ЕС от местен интерес сами или в сътрудничество с Представителството на Европейската комисия, бюрото за връзка на Европейския парламент, други информационни мрежи на ЕС и местни разпространители на информация.

Одобрените кандидати (наричани по-долу „партньори“) ще подпишат рамково споразумение за партньорство с Представителството на Европейската комисия в [България] за периода 2026—2030 г. Всеки партньор може да получава годишни безвъзмездни средства всяка година по покана за представяне на годишен комуникационен план.

Годишните безвъзмездни средства са под формата на еднократна сума, покриваща част от разходите за управление на център EUROPE DIRECT. Партньорът се ангажира да предостави допълнителните финансови и оперативни ресурси, необходими за извършване на дейностите като център EUROPE DIRECT за срока на действие на споразумението за партньорство.

За повече информация прочетете пълния текст на поканата за представяне на предложения и приложенията към нея тук.

callTitle: Selection of partners to carry out EUROPE DIRECT activities (2026-2030) in Czechia
descriptionByte:
Scope:

Evropská komise prostřednictvím svého Zastoupení v České republice vyhlašuje výzvu k předkládání návrhů s cílem vybrat partnery, kteří budou vykonávat činnosti středisek EUROPE DIRECT v období 2026–2030.

Posláním středisek EUROPE DIRECT je přiblížit EU jejím občanům.

Střediska Europe DIRECT:

  • informují o politikách a opatřeních EU
  • naslouchají názorům občanů v oblastech, které spadají do odpovědnosti EU
  • zapojují občany do dialogu o vlivu EU na jejich každodenní život
  • přispívají k evropské občanské výchově
  • přispívají k utváření evropské veřejné sféry

Střediska EUROPE DIRECT jsou dobře propojena s místními komunitami a organizují komunikační a informační činnosti týkající se témat EU místního zájmu, a to samostatně nebo ve spolupráci se Zastoupením Evropské komise, kontaktními kancelářemi Evropského parlamentu, dalšími informačními sítěmi EU a místními multiplikátory.

Úspěšní žadatelé (dále jen „partneři“) podepíší rámcovou dohodu o partnerství se Zastoupením Evropské komise v České republice na období 2026–2030. Partnerovi může být každoročně udělen roční grant na základě výzvy k předložení ročního komunikačního plánu.

Roční grant má podobu jednorázové částky pokrývající část nákladů na provoz střediska EUROPE DIRECT. Partner se zavazuje poskytnout dodatečné finanční a provozní zdroje nezbytné k provádění činností střediska EUROPE DIRECT po dobu trvání dohody o partnerství.

Další informace naleznete v úplném znění výzvy k předkládání návrhů a jejích přílohách zde.
supportInfo:
Potřebujete pomoci?

Před samotnou přípravou přihlášky si prosím pečlivě přečtěte znění výzvy k předkládání návrhů a jejích příloh (včetně příručky pro žadatele).

V případě technických otázek se podívejte na často kladené otázky na stránkách Funding and Tenders Portal – Funding & Tenders Portal FAQ – Submission of proposals.

IT Helpdesk – obraťte se asistenční službu IT v situacích, jako jsou zapomenutá hesla, přístupová práva a role, technické aspekty předkládání návrhů atd.

Potřebujete-li pomoc související s obsahem výzvy, obraťte se prosím na COMM-REP-PRG-EUROPEDIRECT@ec.europa.eu nebo navštivte stránku Zastoupení Evropské komise v České republice.

callTitle: Selection of partners to carry out EUROPE DIRECT activities (2026-2030) in Denmark
descriptionByte:
Scope:

Europa-Kommissionen indkalder via sin repræsentation i Danmark forslag med henblik på at udvælge partnere, der skal udføre aktiviteter som EUROPE DIRECT-centre i perioden 2026-2030.

EUROPE DIRECT-centrene har til opgave at bringe EU tættere på borgerne.

EUROPE DIRECT-centre:

  • informerer om EU's politikker og tiltag
  • lytter til borgernes bekymringer med hensyn til spørgsmål, der hører under EU's ansvarsområde
  • indgår i dialog med borgerne om EU's indvirkning på deres dagligdag
  • bidrager til undervisning i europæisk medborgerkundskab
  • bidrager til skabelsen af et europæisk offentligt rum

EUROPE DIRECT-centrene er lokalt forankrede og tilrettelægger kommunikations- og outreachaktiviteter om EU-emner af lokal interesse alene eller i samarbejde med Kommissionens repræsentation, Europa-Parlamentets forbindelseskontorer, andre EU-outreachnetværk og lokale formidlere.

Ansøgere, der bliver udvalgt (i det følgende benævnt "partnere"), underskriver en rammeaftale om partnerskab med Europa-Kommissionens repræsentation i Danmark for perioden 2026-2030. En partner kan tildeles et årligt tilskud, når den er blevet opfordret til at indsende en årlig kommunikationsplan.

Det årlige tilskud ydes som et fast beløb, der dækker en del af omkostningerne ved driften af et EUROPE DIRECT-center. Partneren forpligter sig til at stille de yderligere finansielle og operationelle ressourcer til rådighed, der er nødvendige for at gennemføre aktiviteter som EUROPE DIRECT-center i partnerskabsaftalens løbetid.

Yderligere oplysninger findes i den fulde ordlyd af indkaldelsen af forslag med bilag her.
supportInfo:
Brug for hjælp

Læs omhyggeligt teksten til indkaldelsen af forslag og bilagene hertil (herunder vejledningen for ansøgere), inden du begynder at udarbejde din ansøgning.

Hvis du har tekniske spørgsmål, kan du læse FAQ Funding Tenders Portal FAQ (FAQ) på portalen for udbud (FAQ) — indsendelse af forslag(FAQ).

IT-helpdesk — Kontakt IT-helpdesken for spørgsmål som f.eks. glemte adgangskoder, adgangsrettigheder og -roller, tekniske aspekter af indsendelse af forslag osv.

Hvis du har brug for hjælp i forbindelse med indkaldelsens indhold, kan du kontakte COMM-REP-DK-EDIC@ec.europa.eu eller se siden https://denmark.representation.ec.europa.eu/kontakt-den-europaeiske-union/kontakter-i-danmark/find-et-eu-center-taet-pa-dig-i-danmark_en

callTitle: Selection of partners to carry out EUROPE DIRECT activities (2026-2030) in Finland
descriptionByte:
Scope:

Euroopan komissio julkaisee Suomen-edustustonsa välityksellä ehdotuspyynnön valitakseen kumppaneita toimimaan EUROPE DIRECT -pisteinä vuosina 2026–2030.

EUROPE DIRECT -pisteiden tehtävänä on hoitaa yleisötiedotusta EU:n jäsenmaissa.

Europe DIRECT -pisteet

  • jakavat tietoa EU:n toimintapolitiikoista ja toimista
  • kuuntelevat kansalaisten kysymyksiä asioista, jotka kuuluvat EU:n vastuulle
  • keskustelevat kansalaisten kanssa siitä, miten EU vaikuttaa heidän arkeensa
  • edistävät eurooppalaista kansalaiskasvatusta
  • auttavat kehittämään eurooppalaista julkisuutta.

EUROPE DIRECT -pisteet tekevät tiivistä yhteistyötä paikallisyhteisöjen kanssa, ja ne järjestävät viestintä- ja tiedotustoimia paikallisesti tärkeistä EU-aiheista joko itse tai yhteistyössä Euroopan komission edustuston, Euroopan parlamentin yhteystoimistojen, muiden EU:n tiedotusverkostojen ja paikallisten mielipidevaikuttajien kanssa.

Valitut hakijat, jäljempänä ’kumppanit’, tekevät kumppanuutta koskevan puitesopimuksen Euroopan komission Suomen-edustuston kanssa vuosiksi 2026–2030. Kumppaneita pyydetään toimittamaan vuotuinen viestintäsuunnitelma, jonka perusteella niille voidaan myöntää vuotuinen avustus.

Vuotuinen avustus myönnetään kertakorvauksena, ja se kattaa osan EUROPE DIRECT -pisteen toiminnasta aiheutuvista kustannuksista. Kumppani sitoutuu tarjoamaan muut taloudelliset ja toiminnalliset resurssit, joita tarvitaan EUROPE DIRECT -pisteen toimien toteuttamiseen kumppanuussopimuksen voimassaoloaikana.

Lisätietoja on ehdotuspyynnössä sekä sen liitteissä.

Europeiska kommissionen utlyser via sin representation i Finland en förslagsinfordran för att välja ut partner som ska bedriva verksamhet som EUROPA DIREKT-kontor för perioden 2026-2030.

EUROPA DIREKT-kontorens uppdrag är att föra EU närmare medborgarna.

EUROPA DIREKT-kontor

  • informerar om EU:s politik och åtgärder,
  • lyssnar på medborgarnas synpunkter om frågor som ingår i EU:s ansvarsområde,
  • för dialog med medborgarna om hur EU påverkar deras vardag,
  • bidrar till den europeiska medborgarutbildningen,
  • bidrar till skapandet av ett europeiskt offentligt rum.

EUROPA DIREKT-kontoren har nära förbindelser med lokalsamhällen och organiserar kommunikation och utåtriktad verksamhet som rör EU-frågor av lokalt intresse, på egen hand eller i samarbete med Europeiska kommissionens representation, Europaparlamentets förbindelsekontor, andra utåtriktade EU-nätverk och lokala informationsspridare.

Godkända sökande (nedan kallade partner) kommer att underteckna ett ramavtal om partnerskap med Europeiska kommissionens representation i Finland för åren 2026-2030. En partner kan varje år beviljas ett årligt bidrag efter inbjudan att lämna in en årlig kommunikationsplan.

Det årliga bidraget ges i form av ett engångsbelopp som täcker en del av kostnaderna för driften av ett EUROPA DIREKT-kontor. Partnern åtar sig att tillhandahålla de ytterligare ekonomiska och operativa resurser som krävs för att bedriva verksamhet som EUROPA DIREKT-kontor under partnerskapsavtalets löptid.

För mer information, se den fullständiga förslagsinfordran och dess bilagor här.
supportInfo:
Tarvitsetko apua?

Tutustu huolellisesti ehdotuspyyntöön ja sen liitteisiin (myös hakuoppaaseen) ennen hakemuksen täyttämistä.

Vastauksia teknisiin kysymyksiin on rahoitus- ja tarjouskilpailuportaalin usein kysyttyjen kysymysten osiossa (Funding & Tenders Portal FAQ – Submission of proposals).

IT Helpdesk – Ota yhteyttä IT-käyttäjätukeen, jos kysymyksesi koskee esimerkiksi unohtunutta salasanaa, käyttöoikeuksia tai ehdotusten jättämiseen liittyvät teknisiä seikkoja.

Jos sinulla on kysymyksiä ehdotuspyynnön sisällöstä, ota yhteyttä osoitteeseen comm-rep-fi-tender@ec.europa.eu tai lue lisätietoja sivulta Tarjouskilpailut ja hankintasopimukset.

Få stöd

Läs noga igenom förslagsinfordran och dess bilagor (inklusive vägledningen för sökande) innan du börjar förbereda din ansökan.

För tekniska frågor kan du vända dig till finansierings- och anbudsportalen – Vanliga frågor och svar – Anbud.

It-support – Kontakta it-supporten för frågor som bortglömda lösenord, åtkomsträttigheter och roller, tekniska aspekter av inlämning av förslag osv.

För hjälp med förslagsinfordrans innehåll, kontakta comm-rep-fi-tender@ec.europa.eu eller gå till sidan Upphandling och kontrakt

title: Selection of partners to carry out EUROPE DIRECT activities
callTitle: Selection of partners to carry out EUROPE DIRECT activities (2026-2030) in France
descriptionByte:
Scope:

La Commission européenne, par l’intermédiaire de sa représentation en France, lance un appel à propositions en vue de sélectionner des partenaires chargés de mener des activités en tant que centres EUROPE DIRECT pour la période 2026-2030.

Les centres EUROPE DIRECT ont pour mission de rapprocher l’Union européenne (UE) de ses citoyens.

Les Centres Europe DIRECT:

  • Fournissent des informations sur les politiques et les actions de l’UE
  • Écoutent les préoccupations des citoyens sur les questions relevant de la responsabilité de l’UE
  • Dialoguent avec les citoyens sur l’impact de l’UE dans leur vie quotidienne
  • Contribuent à l’ éducation civique européenne
  • Contribuent à la création d’une sphère publique européenne

Les centres Europe DIRECT sont bien connectés aux communautés locales et organisent des activités de communication et de sensibilisation sur des sujets européens d’intérêt local, seuls ou en coopération avec la représentation de la Commission européenne, les bureaux de liaison du Parlement européen, d’autres réseaux de sensibilisation de l’UE et des multiplicateurs locaux.

Les candidats retenus (ci-après les «partenaires») signeront une convention-cadre de partenariat avec la représentation de la Commission européenne en France pour les années 2026 à 2030. Un partenaire peut se voir octroyer chaque année une subvention annuelle sur invitation à présenter un plan de communication annuel.

La subvention annuelle prend la forme d’une somme forfaitaire couvrant une partie des coûts de fonctionnement d’un centre EUROPE DIRECT. Le partenaire s’engage à fournir les ressources financières et opérationnelles supplémentaires nécessaires pour mener à bien les activités en tant que centre EUROPE DIRECT pendant la durée de l’accord de partenariat.

Pour en savoir plus, veuillez consulter le texte intégral de l’appel à propositions et de ses annexes ici.
supportInfo:
Besoin d’aide

Veuillez lire attentivement le texte de l’appel à propositions et de ses annexes (y compris le guide à l’intention des candidats) avant de commencer à préparer votre candidature.

Pour les questions techniques, vous pouvez consulter la FAQ sur le portail «Funding &Tenders» du portail «Financement et appels d’offres» — Soumission de propositions.

Helpdesk IT — contactez le helpdesk informatique pour des questions telles que les mots de passe oubliés, les droits d’accès et les rôles, les aspects techniques de la soumission des propositions, etc.

Pour toute aide relative au contenu de l’appel, veuillez contacter COMM-REP-PAR-COMMUNICATION@ec.europa.eu ou consulter la page : https://france.representation.ec.europa.eu/informations/renouvellement-du-reseau-europe-direct-post-2025-2025-02-18_en.

callTitle: Selection of partners to carry out EUROPE DIRECT activities (2026-2030) in Germany
descriptionByte:
Scope:

Die Vertretung der Europäischen Kommission in Deutschland möchte Sie einladen sich als EUROPE DIRECT-Zentrum für den Zeitraum 2026-2030 zu bewerben.

EUROPE DIRECT-Zentren haben die Aufgabe, die EU ihren Bürgerinnen und Bürgern näherzubringen:

  • Informieren über die Arbeit der EU
  • Haben ein offenes Ohr für EU-relevante Anliegen von Bürgerinnen und Bürgern
  • Treten in Dialog mit Bürgerinnen und Bürgern über die Auswirkungen der EU auf ihr Alltagsleben
  • Leisten einen Beitrag zur europäischen politischen Bildung
  • Leisten einen Beitrag zur Schaffung eines europäischen öffentlichen Raums

Die Europe DIRECT-Zentren sind eng mit lokalen Gemeinschaften verbunden und organisieren selbst oder in Zusammenarbeit mit der Vertretung der Europäischen Kommission, den Verbindungsbüros des Europäischen Parlaments, anderen EU-Netzen für Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und lokalen Multiplikatoren Kommunikations- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit zu EU-Themen von lokalem Interesse.

Erfolgreiche Antragsteller (im Folgenden „Partner“) unterzeichnen eine Partnerschaftsrahmenvereinbarung mit der Vertretung der Europäischen Kommission in Deutschland für die Jahre 2026 bis 2030. Partnern wird nach Aufforderung zur Vorlage eines jährlichen Kommunikationsplans jährlich eine Finanzhilfe gewährt.

Die jährliche Finanzhilfe wird in Form eines Pauschalbetrags gewährt, der einen Teil der Kosten für den Betrieb eines EUROPE DIRECT-Zentrums deckt. Der Partner verpflichtet sich, die zusätzlichen finanziellen und operativen Ressourcen bereitzustellen, die für die Durchführung der Tätigkeiten als EUROPE DIRECT-Zentrum während der Laufzeit der Partnerschaftsvereinbarung erforderlich sind.

Weitere Informationen finden Sie in der Aufforderung zur Einreichung von Vorschlägen und ihren Anhängen.

callTitle: Selection of partners to carry out EUROPE DIRECT activities (2026-2030) in Greece
descriptionByte:
Scope:

Η Ευρωπαϊκή Επιτροπή, μέσω της Αντιπροσωπείας της στην Ελλάδα, προκηρύσσει πρόσκληση υποβολής προτάσεων για την επιλογή εταίρων που θα αναλάβουν δραστηριότητες ως κέντρα EUROPE DIRECT για την περίοδο 2026-2030.

Αποστολή των κέντρων EUROPE DIRECT είναι να φέρουν την ΕΕ πιο κοντά στους πολίτες της.

Τα κέντρα Europe DIRECT:

  • Ενημερώνουν σχετικά με τις πολιτικές και τις δράσεις της ΕΕ
  • Αφουγκράζονται τις ανησυχίες των πολιτών για θέματα που εμπίπτουν στην αρμοδιότητα της ΕΕ
  • Συμμετέχουν με τους πολίτες σε διάλογο σχετικά με τον αντίκτυπο της ΕΕ στην καθημερινή τους ζωή
  • Συμβάλλουν στην ευρωπαϊκή αγωγή του πολίτη
  • Συμβάλλουν στη δημιουργία μιας ευρωπαϊκής δημόσιας σφαίρας

Τα κέντρα Europe DIRECT δικτυώνονται επαρκώς με τις τοπικές κοινότητες και διοργανώνουν δραστηριότητες επικοινωνίας και προβολής σχετικά με θέματα τοπικού ενδιαφέροντος της ΕΕ από μόνα τους ή σε συνεργασία με την Αντιπροσωπεία της Ευρωπαϊκής Επιτροπής, τα Γραφεία του Ευρωπαϊκού Κοινοβουλίου, άλλα δίκτυα προβολής της ΕΕ και τοπικούς παράγοντες.

Οι επιτυχόντες υποψήφιοι (στο εξής, «εταίροι») θα υπογράψουν συμφωνία-πλαίσιο εταιρικής σχέσης με την Αντιπροσωπεία της Ευρωπαϊκής Επιτροπής στην Ελλάδα για τα έτη 2026 έως 2030. Κάθε χρόνο μπορεί να χορηγείται στον εταίρο ετήσια επιχορήγηση κατόπιν πρόσκλησης υποβολής ετήσιου σχεδίου επικοινωνίας.

Η ετήσια επιχορήγηση λαμβάνει τη μορφή κατ’ αποκοπή ποσού που καλύπτει μέρος των δαπανών λειτουργίας ενός κέντρου EUROPE DIRECT. Ο εταίρος δεσμεύεται να παράσχει τους πρόσθετους χρηματοδοτικούς και επιχειρησιακούς πόρους που απαιτούνται για την εκτέλεση των δραστηριοτήτων του ως κέντρου EUROPE DIRECT καθ’ όλη τη διάρκεια της συμφωνίας εταιρικής σχέσης.

Για περισσότερες πληροφορίες, διαβάστε το πλήρες κείμενο της πρόσκλησης υποβολής προτάσεων με τα παραρτήματά της.
supportInfo:
Λάβετε υποστήριξη

Διαβάστε προσεκτικά το κείμενο της πρόσκλησης υποβολής προτάσεων και τα παραρτήματά της (συμπεριλαμβανομένου του οδηγού για τους αιτούντες) πριν ξεκινήσετε την προετοιμασία της αίτησής σας.

Για τεχνικές ερωτήσεις, μπορείτε να ανατρέξετε στις συχνές ερωτήσεις της δικτυακής πύλης για τη χρηματοδότηση των προσκλήσεων υποβολής προσφορών — Υποβολή προτάσεων.

Υπηρεσία υποστήριξης ΤΠ — Επικοινωνήστε με το γραφείο υποστήριξης ΤΠ για ερωτήσεις όπως ξεχασμένοι κωδικοί πρόσβασης, δικαιώματα και ρόλοι πρόσβασης, τεχνικές πτυχές της υποβολής προτάσεων κ.λπ.

Για βοήθεια σχετικά με το περιεχόμενο της πρόσκλησης, επικοινωνήστε με την COMM-REP-GR-TENDERS@ec.europa.eu ή συμβουλευτείτε τη σελίδα Αντιπροσωπεία της Ευρωπαϊκής Επιτροπής στην Ελλάδα - Ευρωπαϊκή Επιτροπή.

callTitle: Selection of partners to carry out EUROPE DIRECT activities (2026-2030) in Ireland
descriptionByte:
Scope:

The European Commission, via its Representation in Ireland, is launching a call for proposals to select partners to carry out activities as EUROPE DIRECT centres for the period 2026-2030.

The mission of EUROPE DIRECT centres is to bring the EU closer to its citizens.

EUROPE DIRECT centres:

  • Inform about EU policies and actions
  • Listen to the concerns of citizens on issues that fall under the responsibility of the EU
  • Engage with citizens in a dialogue about the impact of the EU in their everyday lives
  • Contribute to European civic education
  • Contribute to the creation of a European public sphere

EUROPE DIRECT centres are well connected with local communities and organise communication and outreach activities on EU topics of local interest on their own or in cooperation with the European Commission Representation, the European Parliament Liaison Offices, other EU outreach networks and local multipliers.

Successful applicants (hereafter “partners”) will sign a Framework Partnership Agreement with the European Commission Representation in Ireland for the years 2026 to 2030. A partner may be awarded an annual grant each year upon invitation to submit an Annual Communication Plan.

The annual grant takes the form of a lump sum covering part of the costs of running a EUROPE DIRECT centre. The partner commits to providing the additional financial and operational resources necessary to carry out activities as EUROPE DIRECT centre for the duration of the partnership agreement.

For more information read the full text of the call for proposals with its annexes here.

Scope:

La Commissione europea, tramite la sua Rappresentanza in Italia, pubblica un invito a presentare proposte per selezionare partner ai fini dello svolgimento di attività come centri EUROPE DIRECT per il periodo 2026-2030.

La missione dei centri EUROPE DIRECT è avvicinare l'UE ai suoi cittadini.

I centri Europe DIRECT:

  • informano sulle politiche e sulle azioni dell'UE;
  • ascoltano le preoccupazioni dei cittadini su questioni di competenza dell'UE;
  • dialogano con i cittadini sull'impatto dell'UE nella loro vita quotidiana;
  • contribuiscono all'educazione civica europea;
  • contribuiscono alla creazione di una sfera pubblica europea.

I centri EUROPE DIRECT sono ben collegati alle comunità locali e organizzano attività di comunicazione e sensibilizzazione su temi di interesse locale per l'UE, da soli o in collaborazione con la Rappresentanza della Commissione europea, gli Uffici di collegamento del Parlamento europeo, altre reti di sensibilizzazione dell'UE e moltiplicatori locali.

I candidati prescelti (di seguito "partner") firmeranno un accordo quadro di partenariato con la Rappresentanza della Commissione europea in Italia per gli anni dal 2026 al 2030. Un partner può beneficiare ogni anno di una sovvenzione annuale previo invito a presentare un piano annuale di comunicazione.

La sovvenzione annuale viene erogata in forma di un importo forfettario che copre parte dei costi di gestione di un centro EUROPE DIRECT. Il partner si impegna a fornire le risorse finanziarie e operative supplementari necessarie per svolgere le attività in qualità di centro EUROPE DIRECT per la durata dell'accordo di partenariato.

Per maggiori informazioni consultare qui il testo integrale dell'invito a presentare proposte e i relativi allegati.

Europos Komisija per savo atstovybę Lietuvoje skelbia kvietimą teikti paraiškas, kad atrinktų partnerius, kurie 2026–2030 m. vykdys EUROPE DIRECT centrų veiklą.

EUROPE DIRECT centrų misija – priartinti ES prie piliečių.

EUROPE DIRECT centrai:

  • informuoja apie ES politiką ir veiksmus;
  • išklauso piliečių susirūpinimą dėl klausimų, už kuriuos atsakinga ES;
  • užmezga ir palaiko dialogą su piliečiais apie ES poveikį jų kasdieniam gyvenimui;
  • prisideda prie europinio pilietinio ugdymo;
  • prisideda prie Europos viešosios erdvės kūrimo.

EUROPE DIRECT centrai palaiko glaudžius ryšius su vietos bendruomenėmis ir savarankiškai arba bendradarbiaudami su Europos Komisijos atstovybe, Europos Parlamento ryšių biuru, kitais ES informavimo tinklais ir vietos informacijos skleidėjais organizuoja komunikacijos ir informavimo veiklą vietoje svarbiomis ES temomis.

Konkursą laimėję paraiškų teikėjai (toliau – partneriai) su Europos Komisijos atstovybe Lietuvoje pasirašys 2026–2030 m. partnerystės pagrindų susitarimą. Kiekvienais metais partneriui, jei jis pakviečiamas pateikti metinį komunikacijos planą, gali būti skiriama metinė dotacija.

Metinė dotacija skiriama kaip vienkartinė išmoka, kuria padengiama dalis EUROPE DIRECT centro veiklos išlaidų. Partneris įsipareigoja partnerystės susitarimo galiojimo laikotarpiu skirti papildomų finansinių ir veiklos išteklių, reikalingų EUROPE DIRECT centro veiklai vykdyti.

descriptionByte:
Scope:

La Commission européenne, par l’intermédiaire de sa représentation en Luxembourg, lance un appel à propositions en vue de sélectionner des partenaires chargés de mener des activités en tant que centres EUROPE DIRECT pour la période 2026-2030.

Les centres EUROPE DIRECT ont pour mission de rapprocher l’Union européenne (UE) de ses citoyens.

Les Centres Europe DIRECT:

  • Fournissent des informations sur les politiques et les actions de l’UE
  • Écoutent les préoccupations des citoyens sur les questions relevant de la responsabilité de l’UE
  • Dialoguent avec les citoyens sur l’impact de l’UE dans leur vie quotidienne
  • Contribuent à l’ éducation civique européenne
  • Contribuent à la création d’une sphère publique européenne

Les centres Europe DIRECT sont bien connectés aux communautés locales et organisent des activités de communication et de sensibilisation sur des sujets européens d’intérêt local, seuls ou en coopération avec la représentation de la Commission européenne, les bureaux de liaison du Parlement européen, d’autres réseaux de sensibilisation de l’UE et des multiplicateurs locaux.

Les candidats retenus (ci-après les «partenaires») signeront une convention-cadre de partenariat avec la représentation de la Commission européenne en Luxembourg pour les années 2026 à 2030. Un partenaire peut se voir octroyer chaque année une subvention annuelle sur invitation à présenter un plan de communication annuel.

La subvention annuelle prend la forme d’une somme forfaitaire couvrant une partie des coûts de fonctionnement d’un centre EUROPE DIRECT. Le partenaire s’engage à fournir les ressources financières et opérationnelles supplémentaires nécessaires pour mener à bien les activités en tant que centre EUROPE DIRECT pendant la durée de l’accord de partenariat.

Pour en savoir plus, veuillez consulter le texte intégral de l’appel à propositions et de ses annexes ici.

Die Vertretung der Europäischen Kommission in Luxembourg möchte Sie einladen sich als EUROPE DIRECT-Zentrum für den Zeitraum 2026-2030 zu bewerben.

EUROPE DIRECT-Zentren haben die Aufgabe, die EU ihren Bürgerinnen und Bürgern näherzubringen:

  • Informieren über die Arbeit der EU
  • Haben ein offenes Ohr für EU-relevante Anliegen von Bürgerinnen und Bürgern
  • Treten in Dialog mit Bürgerinnen und Bürgern über die Auswirkungen der EU auf ihr Alltagsleben
  • Leisten einen Beitrag zur europäischen politischen Bildung
  • Leisten einen Beitrag zur Schaffung eines europäischen öffentlichen Raums

Die Europe DIRECT-Zentren sind eng mit lokalen Gemeinschaften verbunden und organisieren selbst oder in Zusammenarbeit mit der Vertretung der Europäischen Kommission, den Verbindungsbüros des Europäischen Parlaments, anderen EU-Netzen für Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und lokalen Multiplikatoren Kommunikations- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit zu EU-Themen von lokalem Interesse.

Partnern wird nach Aufforderung zur Vorlage eines jährlichen Kommunikationsplans jährlich eine Finanzhilfe gewährt.

Die jährliche Finanzhilfe wird in Form eines Pauschalbetrags gewährt, der einen Teil der Kosten für den Betrieb eines EUROPE DIRECT-Zentrums deckt. Der Partner verpflichtet sich, die zusätzlichen finanziellen und operativen Ressourcen bereitzustellen, die für die Durchführung der Tätigkeiten als EUROPE DIRECT-Zentrum während der Laufzeit der Partnerschaftsvereinbarung erforderlich sind.

Weitere Informationen finden Sie in der Aufforderung zur Einreichung von Vorschlägen und ihren Anhängen.

The European Commission, via its Representation in Luxembourg, is launching a call for proposals to select partners to carry out activities as EUROPE DIRECT centres for the period 2026-2030.

The mission of EUROPE DIRECT centres is to bring the EU closer to its citizens.

EUROPE DIRECT centres:

  • Inform about EU policies and actions
  • Listen to the concerns of citizens on issues that fall under the responsibility of the EU
  • Engage with citizens in a dialogue about the impact of the EU in their everyday lives
  • Contribute to European civic education
  • Contribute to the creation of a European public sphere

EUROPE DIRECT centres are well connected with local communities and organise communication and outreach activities on EU topics of local interest on their own or in cooperation with the European Commission Representation, the European Parliament Liaison Offices, other EU outreach networks and local multipliers.

Successful applicants (hereafter “partners”) will sign a Framework Partnership Agreement with the European Commission Representation in Luxembourg for the years 2026 to 2030. A partner may be awarded an annual grant each year upon invitation to submit an Annual Communication Plan.

The annual grant takes the form of a lump sum covering part of the costs of running a EUROPE DIRECT centre. The partner commits to providing the additional financial and operational resources necessary to carry out activities as EUROPE DIRECT centre for the duration of the partnership agreement.

callTitle: Selection of partners to carry out EUROPE DIRECT activities (2026-2030) in The Netherlands
descriptionByte:
Scope:

De Europese Commissie lanceert via haar Vertegenwoordiging in Nederland een oproep tot het indienen van voorstellen om partners te selecteren voor het uitvoeren van activiteiten als EUROPE DIRECT-centrum voor de periode 2026-2030.

De EUROPE DIRECT-centra hebben tot taak de EU dichter bij haar burgers te brengen.

Europe DIRECT-centra:

  • informeren over EU-beleid en -acties
  • luisteren naar de zorgen van burgers over kwesties die onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de EU vallen
  • gaan met de burgers een dialoog aan over de impact van de EU op hun dagelijks leven
  • dragen bij aan Europese burgerschapsvorming
  • dragen bij aan de totstandbrenging van een Europese publieke ruimte

De Europe DIRECT-centra onderhouden goede contacten met lokale gemeenschappen en organiseren communicatie- en voorlichtingsactiviteiten over EU-onderwerpen van lokaal belang, alleen of in samenwerking met de Vertegenwoordiging van de Europese Commissie, de liaisonbureaus van het Europees Parlement, andere EU-outreachnetwerken en lokale multiplicatoren.

Succesvolle aanvragers (hierna “partners” genoemd) ondertekenen voor de jaren 2026 tot en met 2030 een partnerschapskaderovereenkomst met de Vertegenwoordiging van de Europese Commissie in Nederland. Aan een partner kan jaarlijks een subsidie worden toegekend na een uitnodiging om een jaarlijks communicatieplan in te dienen.

De jaarlijkse subsidie wordt verleend in de vorm van een vast bedrag dat een deel van de exploitatiekosten van een EUROPE DIRECT-centrum dekt. De partner verbindt zich ertoe de aanvullende financiële en operationele middelen ter beschikking te stellen die nodig zijn om activiteiten als EUROPE DIRECT-centrum uit te voeren voor de duur van de partnerschapsovereenkomst.

Meer informatie vindt u in de volledige tekst van de oproep tot het indienen van voorstellen en de bijlagen daarbij.
supportInfo:

-Leidraad voor aanvragers (zie bijlage 7);

Raadpleeg ook regelmatig de pagina betreffende het onderwerp voor updates van oproepen tot het indienen van voorstellen.

Contact

Voor individuele vragen in verband met het elektronische indieningssysteem kunt u terecht bij de IT-helpdesk.

Niet-IT-gerelateerde vragen moeten naar het volgende e-mailadres worden gezonden: COMM-NL-administratie@ec.europa.eu.

Vermeld duidelijk de referentie van de oproep en het onderwerp waarop uw vraag betrekking heeft.

Vragen worden uitsluitend schriftelijk aanvaard op het hierboven vermelde e-mailadres, tot en met 10 juni 2025. Er worden geen vragen telefonisch beantwoord.

Vragen en antwoorden worden binnen vijf werkdagen na ontvangst gepubliceerd op https://netherlands.representation.ec.europa.eu/zakendoen-en-financiering/financiering-en-subsidies_nl.

descriptionByte:
Scope:

Komisja Europejska, za pośrednictwem Przedstawicielstwa w Polsce, ogłasza zaproszenie do składania wniosków w celu wybrania partnerów do prowadzenia punktów EUROPE DIRECT w latach 2026-2030.

Misją punktów EUROPE DIRECT jest zbliżenie UE do jej obywateli.

Punkty EUROPE DIRECT:

  • informują o politykach i działaniach UE;
  • wysłuchują uwag obywateli dotyczących kwestii wchodzących w zakres odpowiedzialności UE;
  • angażują obywateli w dialog na temat wpływu UE na ich codzienne życie;
  • uczestniczą w europejskiej edukacji obywatelskiej;
  • przyczyniają się do tworzenia europejskiej sfery publicznej.

Punkty EUROPE DIRECT są dobrze powiązane ze społecznościami lokalnymi i podejmują działania informacyjne i komunikacyjne na tematy związane z UE będące przedmiotem zainteresowania społeczności lokalnej, samodzielnie lub we współpracy z Przedstawicielstwami Komisji Europejskiej, Biurami Parlamentu Europejskiego, innymi sieciami informacyjnymi UE i lokalnymi podmiotami opiniotwórczymi.

Wybrani wnioskodawcy (zwani dalej „partnerami”) podpiszą umowę ramową o partnerstwie z Przedstawicielstwem Komisji Europejskiej w Polsce na lata 2026–2030. Partnerowi może co roku zostać przyznana dotacja roczna na podstawie zaproszenia do przedłożenia rocznego planu komunikacji.

Roczna dotacja jest w formie kwoty ryczałtowej pokrywającej część kosztów prowadzenia punktu EUROPE DIRECT. Partner zobowiązuje się do zapewnienia dodatkowych zasobów finansowych i operacyjnych niezbędnych do prowadzenia działań punktu EUROPE DIRECT w okresie obowiązywania umowy o partnerstwie.

Więcej informacji można znaleźć w pełnym tekście zaproszenia do składania wniosków wraz z załącznikami.
supportInfo:
Przed rozpoczęciem przygotowywania wniosku prosimy o dokładne zapoznanie się z tekstem zaproszenia do składania wniosków wraz z załącznikami do niego (w tym z przewodnikiem dla wnioskodawców).

Pytania techniczne można znaleźć na portalu Funding & Tenders Portal FAQ – Składanie wniosków.

IT Helpdesk – skontaktuj się z działem pomocy technicznej w kwestiach takich, jak zapomniane hasła, prawa dostępu i role, techniczne aspekty składania wniosków itp.

Aby uzyskać pomoc związaną z treścią zaproszenia, prosimy o kontakt COMM-REP-PL-ED-CALL@ec.europa.eu lub o zapoznanie się ze stroną stronie internetowej.

descriptionByte:
Scope:

Comisia Europeană, prin intermediul Reprezentanței sale din România, lansează o cerere de propuneri pentru selectarea partenerilor care să desfășoare activități ca centre EUROPE DIRECT pentru perioada 2026-2030.

Misiunea centrelor EUROPE DIRECT este de a aduce UE mai aproape de cetățenii săi.

Centrele Europe DIRECT:

  • Informează cu privire la politicile și acțiunile UE
  • Ascultă preocupărilor cetățenilor cu privire la chestiuni care țin de responsabilitatea UE
  • Implică cetățenii într-un dialog cu privire la impactul UE în viața lor de zi cu zi
  • Contribuie la educația civică europeană
  • Contribuie la crearea unei sfere publice europene

Centrele Europe DIRECT sunt bine conectate cu comunitățile locale și organizează activități de comunicare și de informare cu privire la subiecte ale UE de interes local pe cont propriu sau în cooperare cu Reprezentanța Comisiei Europene, cu birourile de legătură ale Parlamentului European, cu alte rețele de informare ale UE și cu multiplicatorii locali.

Candidații selectați (denumiți în continuare „parteneri”) vor semna un acord-cadru de parteneriat cu Reprezentanța Comisiei Europene în România pentru perioada 2026-2030. Unui partener i se poate acorda o subvenție anuală în fiecare an, pe baza unei invitații de a prezenta un plan anual de comunicare.

Grantul anual ia forma unei sume forfetare care acoperă o parte din costurile de funcționare a unui centru EUROPE DIRECT. Partenerul se angajează să furnizeze resursele financiare și operaționale suplimentare necesare pentru desfășurarea activităților în calitate de centru EUROPE DIRECT pe durata acordului de parteneriat.

Pentru mai multe informații, citiți textul integral al cererii de propuneri și anexele sale aici.

descriptionByte:
Scope:

Európska komisia prostredníctvom svojho zastúpenia na Slovensku uverejňuje výzvu na predkladanie návrhov s cieľom vybrať partnerov na vykonávanie činností centier EUROPE DIRECT na obdobie 2026 – 2030.

Poslaním centier EUROPE DIRECT je priblížiť EÚ jej občanom.

Európske centrá budú:

  • Informovať o politikách a opatreniach EÚ
  • Vypočuť si obavy občanov v súvislosti s otázkami, za ktoré zodpovedá EÚ
  • Zapojiť občanov do dialógu o vplyve EÚ na ich každodenný život
  • Prispievať k európskej občianskej výchove
  • Prispieť k vytvoreniu európskej verejnej sféry

Centrá Europe DIRECT sú dobre prepojené s miestnymi komunitami a organizujú komunikačné a osvetové činnosti o témach miestneho záujmu EÚ samostatne alebo v spolupráci so zastúpením Európskej komisie, styčnými kanceláriami Európskeho parlamentu, inými osvetovými sieťami EÚ a miestnymi multiplikátormi.

Úspešní uchádzači (ďalej len „partneri“) podpíšu rámcovú dohodu o partnerstve so zastúpením Európskej komisie na Slovensku na roky 2026 až 2030. Partnerovi sa môže udeliť ročný grant každý rok na základe výzvy na predloženie ročného komunikačného plánu.

Ročný grant má formu jednorazovej platby pokrývajúcej časť nákladov na prevádzku centra EUROPE DIRECT. Partner sa zaväzuje poskytnúť dodatočné finančné a prevádzkové zdroje potrebné na vykonávanie činností centra EUROPE DIRECT počas trvania dohody o partnerstve.

Viac informácií nájdete v úplnom znení výzvy na predkladanie návrhov s prílohami tu.

Ak potrebujete pomoc v súvislosti s obsahom výzvy, kontaktujte Zastúpenie Európskej Komisie na Slovensku: COMM-REP-SK-GRANTS@ec.europa.eu , alebo si prečítajte stránku: https://commission.europa.eu/.

callTitle: Selection of partners to carry out EUROPE DIRECT activities (2026-2030) in Slovenia
descriptionByte:
Scope:

Evropska komisija prek svojega predstavništva v Sloveniji objavlja razpis za zbiranje predlogov za izbiro partnerjev za izvajanje dejavnosti centrov EUROPE DIRECT za obdobje 2026–2030.

Naloga centrov EUROPE DIRECT je približati EU njenim državljanom.

Centri EUROPE DIRECT:

  • Informirajo o politikah in ukrepih EU
  • Prisluhnejo mnenjem državljanov glede evropskih vsebin
  • Razpravljajo z državljani o vplivu EU na njihovo vsakdanje življenje
  • Prispevajo h krepitvi aktivnega državljanstva
  • Prispevajo k oblikovanju evropskega javnega prostora

Centri EUROPE DIRECT so dobro povezani z lokalnimi skupnostmi ter sami ali v sodelovanju s predstavništvi Evropske komisije, pisarnami Evropskega parlamenta za stike, drugimi mrežami EU za ozaveščanje in lokalnimi deležniki organizirajo dejavnosti o evropskih temah, ki so v lokalnem interesu.

Uspešni prijavitelji (v nadaljnjem besedilu: partnerji) bodo podpisali okvirni sporazum o partnerstvu s Predstavništvom Evropske komisije v Sloveniji za obdobje 2026–2030. Partnerju se lahko na povabilo k predložitvi letnega komunikacijskega načrta vsako leto dodelijo letna nepovratna sredstva.

Letna nepovratna sredstva so v obliki pavšalnega zneska, ki krije del stroškov vodenja centra EUROPE DIRECT. Partner se zavezuje, da bo med trajanjem partnerskega sporazuma zagotovil dodatna finančna in operativna sredstva, potrebna za izvajanje dejavnosti centra EUROPE DIRECT.

Za več informacij preberite celotno besedilo razpisa za zbiranje predlogov s prilogami.
supportInfo:
Preden začnete s pripravo prijave, pozorno preberite besedilo razpisa za zbiranje predlogov in njegove priloge (vključno z vodnikom za prijavitelje).

Odgovori na pogosta tehnična vprašanja so na voljo na portalu za financiranje in razpise – Pogosta vprašanja – predložitev predlogov.

Služba IKT za pomoč uporabnikom – obrnite se na službo za pomoč uporabnikom za vprašanja, kot so pozabljena gesla, pravice dostopa in vloge, tehnični vidiki predložitve predlogov itd.

Za pomoč v zvezi z vsebino razpisa se obrnite na COMM-REP-LJU-TENDERS-ADMIN@ec.europa.eu ali obiščite stran https://slovenia.representation.ec.europa.eu/index_sl.

callTitle: Selection of partners to carry out EUROPE DIRECT activities (2026-2030) in Spain
descriptionByte:
Scope:

La Comisión Europea, a través de su Representación en España, pone en marcha una convocatoria de propuestas para seleccionar a los socios que lleven a cabo actividades como centros EUROPE DIRECT para el período 2026-2030.

La misión de los centros EUROPE DIRECT es acercar la UE a sus ciudadanos.

Los centros Europe DIRECT:

  • Informan sobre las políticas y acciones de la UE
  • Escuchan las preocupaciones de los ciudadanos sobre cuestiones que son responsabilidad de la UE
  • Dialogan con los ciudadanos sobre el impacto de la UE en su vida cotidiana
  • Contribuyen a la educación cívica europea
  • Contribuyen a la creación de una esfera pública europea

Los centros Europe DIRECT están bien conectados con las comunidades locales y organizan actividades de comunicación y divulgación sobre temas de interés local de la UE por sí solos o en cooperación con la Representación de la Comisión Europea, las oficinas de enlace del Parlamento Europeo, otras redes de divulgación de la UE y multiplicadores locales.

Los solicitantes seleccionados (en lo sucesivo, «socios») firmarán un acuerdo marco de asociación con la Representación de la Comisión Europea en España para los años 2026 a 2030. Cada año se podrá conceder una subvención anual al socio, previa invitación a presentar un plan de comunicación anual.

La subvención anual adopta la forma de una cantidad a tanto alzado que cubre parte de los costes de funcionamiento de un centro EUROPE DIRECT. El socio se compromete a proporcionar los recursos financieros y operativos adicionales necesarios para llevar a cabo actividades como centro EUROPE DIRECT durante el período de vigencia del acuerdo de asociación.

Para más información, consulte el texto completo de la convocatoria de propuestas y sus anexos aquí.

descriptionByte:
Scope:

Europeiska kommissionen utlyser via sin representation i Sverige en förslagsinfordran för att välja ut partner som ska bedriva verksamhet som EUROPA DIREKT-kontor för perioden 2026-2030.

EUROPA DIREKT-kontorens uppdrag är att föra EU närmare medborgarna.

EUROPA DIREKT-kontor

  • informerar om EU:s politik och åtgärder,
  • lyssnar på medborgarnas synpunkter om frågor som ingår i EU:s ansvarsområde,
  • för dialog med medborgarna om hur EU påverkar deras vardag,
  • bidrar till den europeiska medborgarutbildningen,
  • bidrar till skapandet av ett europeiskt offentligt rum.

EUROPA DIREKT-kontoren har nära förbindelser med lokalsamhällen och organiserar kommunikation och utåtriktad verksamhet som rör EU-frågor av lokalt intresse, på egen hand eller i samarbete med Europeiska kommissionens representation, Europaparlamentets förbindelsekontor, andra utåtriktade EU-nätverk och lokala informationsspridare.

Godkända sökande (nedan kallade partner) kommer att underteckna ett ramavtal om partnerskap med Europeiska kommissionens representation i Sverige för åren 2026-2030. En partner kan varje år beviljas ett årligt bidrag efter inbjudan att lämna in en årlig kommunikationsplan.

Det årliga bidraget ges i form av ett engångsbelopp som täcker en del av kostnaderna för driften av ett EUROPA DIREKT-kontor. Partnern åtar sig att tillhandahålla de ytterligare ekonomiska och operativa resurser som krävs för att bedriva verksamhet som EUROPA DIREKT-kontor under partnerskapsavtalets löptid.

För mer information, se den fullständiga förslagsinfordran och dess bilagor här.
